# Mohammadhossein Mohammadi (Mo)

> Mohammadhossein Mohammadi, who goes by Mo Mohammadi, holds an M.A. in Philosophy, Politics & Economics (Witten/Herdecke University, 2026) and a B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, and has hands-on GMP cleanroom manufacturing experience. Mo is based in the 's-Hertogenbosch area, North Brabant, the Netherlands, and is open to roles that fit this profile, especially in innovation, sustainability, energy transition, policy and strategy, as well as engineering. Mo is authorised to work in the Netherlands.

- Website: https://realmohere.github.io/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/mohammadhossein-m-55290210a
- GitHub: https://github.com/realmohere
- Contact: see the Contact section of https://realmohere.github.io/

## The route so far

2016 Mechanical Engineering → 2019 International Trade → 2024 Green Energy Innovation Projects → 2025 GMP Cleanroom Manufacturing → 2026 M.A. Philosophy, Politics & Economics → next: Innovation & Sustainability.

## Experience

- Production Operator, ViCentra (Kaleido), Utrecht, NL (Jun 2025 – Sep 2026): GMP cleanroom line for insulin pumps. Introduced pre-staging of critical components before Base Assembly, cutting waiting time. Found a recurring cable-interference risk in a production machine, which led to a permanent engineering fix.
- Project Assistant, Duisburg Business & Innovation GmbH, DE (Mar 2024 – Sep 2024): green-energy and regional innovation projects: milestone and risk tracking, technical, market and funding research; master's thesis on circular-economy transitions.
- Business Development Consultant, 1&1 AG, Düsseldorf, DE (Mar 2023 – Feb 2024): Python automation for network monitoring and quality reporting.
- Instructor, Warehouse Operations, Amazon (DTM9), Witten, DE (Jun 2022 – Mar 2023).
- Regional Country Manager, Taiwan Trade Center, Tehran (Dec 2019 – Dec 2020).
- Assistant Mechanical Engineer, Saba-Sim Co., Isfahan (Jul 2017 – Jun 2019): improvements that raised operational efficiency by more than 20%; failure analysis, AutoCAD design, Ansys analysis, cost estimates.

## Projects

Building now:
- Meetout (2026, in development): mobile-first app for meeting new people around Oss through small public hangouts, with join requests, group chat and references after meeting. React, TypeScript, Firebase, Android.
- Dogout (2026, in development): dog play dates in Noord-Brabant, starting in Oss; matches dogs by energy, size and play style. Built from the Meetout codebase, Dutch and English.
- Tend (2026, prototype): a no-shame, CBT-informed life game for adults with ADHD, run with a team of AI role agents.
- This website (2026, live): plain HTML on GitHub Pages with structured data, sitemap, Search Console/Bing, cookieless analytics.

Research and study:
- M.A. thesis "From Linear to Circular": policy pathways for economic resilience and sustainability in Duisburg's post-industrial transition, with Amsterdam and Singapore as comparative cases; written with Duisburg Business & Innovation GmbH.
- Zon op Haarlemmermeer (2025, VU Amsterdam team case study): marketing and buy-in strategy for a citizen energy cooperative's ~400-panel municipal solar roof (20% of shares sold, 70% needed), with stakeholder mapping and a value-exchange model.

Engineering and tools:
- AI workflow automation (2026): Python pipelines that check online sources on a schedule, filter and score items with AI, draft tailored documents and wait for human approval before anything is sent; an AI-to-AI review loop with regression tests and command audit.
- Hydrogen-generation prototype (personal side project): designed, built and tested a steel-plate hydrogen-generation system.
- GPT-based research assistant that identifies start-ups and organises contacts by country and city.

## Volunteering

- Conference Organizer (marketing team), 8th International Philosophy, Politics & Economics Conference, Universität Witten/Herdecke (Mar 2023 – Apr 2024). Theme: "Generation on the EDGE: Environment, Democracy, Globalization and Economics". Shaped how the event was presented and communicated: designed banners and logos, created social media content, promoted the conference across campus, developed posts on speakers, sessions and key dates, and planned the outreach strategy with the team.
